note: Stage 7 (2026-10-20, [У]): split of the basket directions that pass the selection criteria (SHARED_UNDERSTANDING «Выпавшие законопроекты и направления без вопроса»; local/research/basket_split/). Procedure of 2026-10-16 (Opus proposes parts; a part that is an existing direction is a transfer); the choice is made by Sonnet subagents instead of Jev; sign asked per part.

163p1.plus_en: Religious courts get wider powers, such as arbitrating civil disputes or ruling by consent of the parties
163p1.minus_en: Religious courts' powers stay limited to their current areas or shrink

163p2.plus_en: More state money and discounts for yeshivas, Haredi schools, religious councils, houses of prayer and holy sites
163p2.minus_en: Less state funding and fewer discounts for religious institutions and schools

256s3p1.plus_en: Schools must teach Arabic to Jewish pupils and Hebrew to Arab pupils
256s3p1.minus_en: Schools have no duty to teach the other national language

256s3p2.plus_en: Schools must teach gender equality, tolerance and prevention of sexual harassment, and train staff on these topics
256s3p2.minus_en: Such programs stay optional for schools

122s1p1.name_ru: Penalties for election fraud and deepfakes
122s1p1.name_en: Penalties for election fraud and deepfakes
122s1p1.plus_en: Harsher penalties and disclosure duties for ballot fraud and AI-made fake content in election campaigns
122s1p1.minus_en: Current penalties and fewer restrictions on campaign content

122s1p2.name_ru: Special arrangements for local elections in emergencies
122s1p2.name_en: Special arrangements for local elections in emergencies
122s1p2.plus_en: Local-election dates and rules may be changed or postponed by temporary orders or ministerial decision in emergencies
122s1p2.minus_en: Local elections held on schedule under the standard rules

95s2p1.name_ru: Limits on police force at protests
95s2p1.name_en: Limits on police force at protests
95s2p1.plus_en: Stricter rules on how police disperse protests and use force, with body cameras and accountability for police violence
95s2p1.minus_en: Police keep broad discretion to disperse assemblies and use force

95s2p2.name_ru: State compensation for wrongful detention and prosecution
95s2p2.name_en: State compensation for wrongful detention and prosecution
95s2p2.plus_en: Wider state liability to compensate people wrongly detained, shackled, prosecuted or later acquitted
95s2p2.minus_en: Narrower state liability for such compensation
